title: Add anonymous user CTA banner on song page
description: Show a call-to-action banner on the song page for anonymous users who have progress, encouraging them to sign up to save their progress across devices.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Banner only shows for anonymous users
Banner only shows when user has some progress (words/lines learned > 0)
Banner shows progress summary: 'You've learned X words!'
Banner has clear CTA: 'Sign up to save progress across devices'
Banner is dismissible (dismiss state persists in localStorage)
Banner does not obstruct main UI (positioned tastefully)
Banner does not show for authenticated users
Verify in browser: banner appears for anonymous with progress

technicalNotes: Use useProgress() hook to check for progress
Position at top of lyrics section or bottom of page
Use existing design system colors (emerald for CTA)
testingNotes: Manual test: banner appears after marking first word learned
Manual test: banner dismisses and stays dismissed
Manual test: banner does not appear for logged-in users
Manual test: clicking CTA navigates to signup
